headline: Japan State Fund to Sell JSR to Mitsui Chemicals for $8.2 Billion
summary: Japan's state fund agreed to sell JSR to Mitsui Chemicals in an $8.2 billion transaction.
why: Large corporate acquisitions involving state-backed divestments reshuffle market concentration and capital allocations within the specialty chemicals and materials sector.
